evidence.source: 2025 article in 杜甫研究学刊, hosted as PDF
evidence.field: pp. 1–2: dating and early attestations of 影
evidence.text: The article reviews competing proposed first attestations: a Han-end attribution to Gao You’s 淮南子 commentary, a claim based on the lost Zhang Heng stele, and Ge Hong’s 字苑 as reported by Yan Zhitui. It argues that the earliest presently supportable example is the Eastern Jin 爨寶子碑, dated 405, whose preserved rubbing has “影命不長”; it also notes Tao Yuanming’s 形影神 poem titles. The article cautions that ancient-text editions sometimes replace 景 with 影. The 405 date and reading are reported through later scholarship and a Qing rubbing, so this is not an extant contemporary original inspected here.
